     -> {name Tom age 100 tags [user admin "a b c"]}
 
-  Pretty output:
+  Pretty output uses fuzzy layout rules:
+    - Scalars and small structures stay inline when they fit.
+    - Objects with 3+ fields are always expanded (opening brace on same line as key).
+    - Lists containing non-scalar elements are always expanded.
+    - Opening { and [ stay on the same line as the key name.
+
+  Example:
     {
       name Tom
       age 100
       tags [user admin "a b c"]
-      meta {active true empty null}
+      address {
+        street "1 Main St"
+        city Springfield
+      }
+      meta {active true}
     }
-
-  Compact pretty output keeps nested records/lists inline when they fit within
-  the configured width budget.
   """
 
   @reserved_atoms MapSet.new([

+  # Fuzzy heuristics: expand even when compact form fits within width.
+  # Objects with 3+ fields and lists with any non-scalar element are expanded
+  # so that complex structures remain readable at a glance.
+  defp should_expand?({:object, entries}), do: length(entries) > 2
+  defp should_expand?(list) when is_list(list), do: Enum.any?(list, &(not scalar?(&1)))
+  defp should_expand?(_), do: false
+
   defp fits?(text, level, opts, extra_prefix_len \\ 0) do
     String.length(text) + level * @indent_unit + extra_prefix_len <= opts.width
   end
